items.title: Joe Loyacano Interview, 1959-08-20
items.q: I played trombone. And uh, Ballet Rite played drums. My brother played bass horn. And uh, that was all.

ctx.x: Is he still around Clem Camp?
No, I don't know. I don't know whether he's still living or not. I played trombone. And uh, Ballet Rite played drums. My brother played bass horn. And uh, that was all.
